project_context.primary_goal: High-speed, error-free operations for staff under pressure. Clear touch targets, explicit feedback, high readability.

palette.primaryGreen: Use existing (e.g., #10B981) - Use for confirm/success actions and selected states
palette.primaryOrange: Use existing (e.g., #F97316) - Use for warnings or secondary highlights
palette.darkText: Use existing - For primary item names and headers
palette.grayText: Use existing - For secondary info, quantities, unselected hints
palette.sectionBg: Use existing - For unselected item row backgrounds or modal canvas

surface_strategies.modal_backdrop: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md - High-end glass to maintain context without visual noise.
surface_strategies.modal_card: bg-white shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] - Solid background to prevent text refraction.
surface_strategies.selected_row: bg-primaryGreen/5 border border-primaryGreen/20 - Clear visual confirmation without overwhelming saturation.
surface_strategies.disabled_row: opacity-50 grayscale - Immediately readable as non-interactive.

icons.usage: ArrowRightLeft (trigger button), CheckSquare (selected), Square (unselected), Info (disabled hint)
icons.styling: stroke-2 for legibility. DO NOT use emojis.

spacing.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height for all rows and buttons.
spacing.generous_padding: Use p-6 or p-8 inside the modal. The grid must feel breathable.

cart_panel_trigger.name: MoveToTableButton
cart_panel_trigger.placement: Contextual banner/button directly adjacent to the 'Placed Items' header. DO NOT place at the bottom billing section.
cart_panel_trigger.styling: h-9 px-3 rounded-full border border-borderGray bg-white text-darkText hover:bg-gray-50 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
cart_panel_trigger.behavior: Visible ONLY if isRoom=true AND placedItems.length > 0.

split_room_items_modal.name: SplitRoomItemsModal
split_room_items_modal.layout: fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4
split_room_items_modal.card_styling: bg-white rounded-2xl w-full max-w-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh]

header.styling: p-6 border-b border-borderGray flex items-start justify-between bg-white z-10
header.title: text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-darkText
header.subtitle: text-sm text-grayText mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 (e.g., 'Moving from Room 101')

body.item_row: flex items-center justify-between p-4 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer min-h-[4rem]
body.checkbox_custom: Do not use standard tiny checkboxes. The entire row is the touch target. Use Lucide CheckCircle2 (filled/green) vs Circle (outline/gray) on the left side of the row.

remark_field.styling: mx-4 mb-4 p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-borderGray
remark_field.input: w-full bg-transparent border-none text-sm focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-gray-400 resize-none h-10
remark_field.label: text-xs font-bold text-grayText uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 block

footer.styling: p-6 border-t border-borderGray bg-white flex items-center justify-between sticky bottom-0
footer.cancel_button: px-6 py-3 rounded-xl border border-borderGray text-darkText font-medium hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors
footer.confirm_button: px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-primaryGreen text-white font-bold disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-all flex items-center gap-2

layouts.bento_grid_protocol: Not applicable for this specific modal, but use 'High Density Grid' principles for the POS order list. Ensure full width utilization, optical alignment for prices vs item names.
layouts.alignment: Prices strictly right-aligned (tabular-nums). Item names and checkboxes left-aligned. Quantities prominently displayed next to item names (e.g., '2x Burger').

motion.row_selection: Scale down slightly on active click (active:scale-[0.99]), fast color transition (duration-150)

accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs) MUST have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primaryGreen/50 outline-none.
accessibility.aria_labels: Buttons must have descriptive aria-labels. Selected rows should have aria-selected='true'.
accessibility.touch_targets: Ensure minimum 48px touch targets for staff operating on tablets.
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY. Add 'data-testid' to trigger button ('move-items-trigger'), modal ('split-items-modal'), item rows ('split-item-row-{id}'), check-in item ('split-item-checkin'), confirm button ('split-confirm-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React.js (.jsx files, NO .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Lucide React icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use a standard React `useState` array or Set for selected item IDs. The row's `onClick` toggles the ID in the state.
instructions_to_main_agent.filtering: Identify the 'check-in marker' based on existing data flags (e.g., `isCheckIn`, `price === 0 && name.includes('Room')`, or specific item categories) and render it in the `item_row_disabled` style. Prevent its ID from being added to the selected state.
instructions_to_main_agent.dynamic_footer: Calculate the running total by mapping selected IDs to their item prices and summing them up. Format as currency.
instructions_to_main_agent.cart_panel_integration: Locate the Placed Items section header in `CartPanel.jsx`. Insert the trigger button flex-aligned with the header text. Wrap in a condition checking for `isRoom` and `placedItems.length > 0`.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure: Create `SplitRoomItemsModal.jsx` (likely in `/app/frontend/src/components/` or equivalent modal directory). Update `CartPanel.jsx`.
instructions_to_main_agent.z_index: Existing modals use z-[100]. Ensure the backdrop and modal card align with this.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (backdrop-blur-md).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always target specific properties like transition-colors, transition-transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center to the root CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, active states, focus rings.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Specifically in this POS, space out the item rows.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
